description: This PHP class defines a model named EmployeeClaimRequestModel within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It represents an API data structure for an employee claim request, including properties like claim event, currency type, employee details, claim amount, status, and submitted date. The class uses annotations for OpenAPI schema generation and includes logic to serialize ClaimRequest entity data into an API response-compatible format.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee claim request data for API responses, constructed from ClaimRequest entity with defined filters and attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with ClaimRequest entity data, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
